english.title: Obstruct a relevant person in performance of anything required by Parts 1 to 4 and 7 of the Housing Act 2004
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a relevant person in the performance of a function, namely **(..SPECIFY FUNCTION..), which by virtue of Part **(..SPECIFY PART..) of the Housing Act 2004, that person was required or authorised to do
english.legislation: Contrary to section 241(1) and (3) of the Housing Act 2004.
